beehive-im Go 依赖 (govendor 风格 vendor 目录)

构建要求:
  export GOPATH=<项目>/gopath
  export GO111MODULE=off
  make 会自动创建 gopath/src/beehive-im 软链

依赖版本 (2026-06-12 固定):
  github.com/astaxie/beego                         v1.12.3
  github.com/garyburd/redigo                       master
  github.com/go-sql-driver/mysql                   v1.5.0
  github.com/golang/protobuf                       v1.3.5
  github.com/gorilla/websocket                     v1.4.2
  github.com/shiena/ansicolor                      master
  github.com/hashicorp/golang-lru                  v0.5.4
  github.com/cespare/xxhash                        v2.1.2
  github.com/beorn7/perks                          master
  github.com/prometheus/client_golang              v1.11.1
  github.com/prometheus/client_model               v0.2.0
  github.com/prometheus/common                     v0.26.0
  github.com/prometheus/procfs                     v0.6.0
  github.com/golang/snappy                         master
  github.com/matttproud/golang_protobuf_extensions v1.0.1
  gopkg.in/mgo.v2                                  r2015.06.03
  gopkg.in/yaml.v2                                 v2.4.0
  git.apache.org/thrift.git                        0.9.3
  golang.org/x/crypto                              v0.8.0
  golang.org/x/net                                 v0.10.0
  golang.org/x/sys                                 v0.7.0
  golang.org/x/text                                v0.9.0

重新拉取依赖 (需网络):
  1. 确保 gopath/src/beehive-im 软链存在
  2. 按上述版本 git clone 到 gopath/src/
  3. 复制 github.com gopkg.in golang.org git.apache.org 到 vendor/
